<thought>The most intense peak is at m/z 100.0524, which in positive‑mode ESI corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the proton mass (1.0073 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈ 99.045 Da. A formula that matches this mass within high‑resolution tolerance is C₅H₇O₂ (exact neutral mass 99.0446 Da, [M+H]⁺ 100.0519 Da). No other common CHO composition fits as closely. Therefore the molecular formula of the sample is C5H7O2.</thought>
<final_answer>C5H7O2</final_answer>
